# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: North Korea 1970 national programme.
# Generated by tools/north_korea_1970/compile.py.
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = NKO }
				NKO = { COLDWAR_NKO_initialize = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	on_daily = {
		effect = {
			COLDWAR_NKO_world_succession_daily = yes
			if = {
				limit = { tag = NKO IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
				COLDWAR_NKO_daily = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_weekly_NKO = {
		effect = { COLDWAR_NKO_initialize = yes }
	}
	on_government_change = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { original_tag = NKO IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
				COLDWAR_NKO_refresh_programmes = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_ruling_party_change = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { original_tag = NKO IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
				COLDWAR_NKO_refresh_programmes = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_war_relation_added = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = NKO
					OR = {
						original_tag = NKO
						FROM = { original_tag = NKO }
					}
				}
				NKO = {
					if = {
						limit = { IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
						COLDWAR_NKO_foreign_refresh = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_peaceconference_ended = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = NKO }
				NKO = {
					if = {
						limit = { IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
						COLDWAR_NKO_foreign_refresh = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
